quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this before we go outside to build a snowman or make snow angels, not your jacket. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear this to play in deep snow.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: They often cover the entire body from the ankles up to the neck.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this like a superhero wears while flying through the sky, not your suspenders. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It has no sleeves and no arms at all.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: A small cape attached to a dress is sometimes called a capelet.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that helps us float safely on top of the water, not your uniform. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear this to stay safe near deep water.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: It is a crucial piece of safety equipment for any water sports.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that is hard on the outside to protect us from a bump, not your beanie. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It buckles under your chin.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: Soldiers, athletes, and astronauts all wear special types of helmets.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a hoodie, when we want warmth without a hood, not your vest. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Athletes often wear these after a game to stay warm.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: A sweatshirt with a hood is called a hoodie.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our legs, stretchy and snug from waist to ankle. It is also worn instead of jeans when we want something soft and flexible, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You can wear these under a skirt or dress.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: They are usually made from a mix of cotton and spandex.

quests.instruction: We wear this that zips or buttons up the front. It is also worn to keep warm without wearing a heavy coat, but it is NOT your helmet. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It has long sleeves and often a zipper.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Did you know? windbreaker jackets are made of special nylon to block the wind.

quests.instruction: We wear this around our collar for a fancy, formal outfit. It is also worn to a wedding or a very special occasion, but it is NOT your bow tie. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this for a fancy, formal event.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Neckties evolved from scarves worn by soldiers hundreds of years ago.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part of shorts or a skirt that sits right on our waist? It is not your zipper!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: This is a small feature sewn onto something bigger!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Waistband is the snug strip of fabric at the top of pants, around your waist!
quests.funFact: Sweatpants have very soft waistbands with a drawstring you can tie.

quests.instruction: We wear this that sits right on top of our hair. It is also worn when we want to keep our head warm in winter, but it is NOT your vest. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It covers your hair.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Did you know? there are thousands of different styles of hats around the world.

quests.instruction: We wear this to go swimming in a pool or at the beach. It is also worn on a hot day when we want to splash and float, but it is NOT your onesie. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You change into this before jumping in a pool.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: Wetsuits are special swimsuits made of neoprene to keep surfers warm.

quests.instruction: What do we call the collection that can be simple for school or fancy for a party? It is not your tie!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the name for ALL your clothes together!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Outfit is the name for the whole set of clothes you wear together!
quests.funFact: An astronaut's spacesuit is an incredibly complex, life-saving outfit.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is taller and sturdier than regular shoes. It is also worn to keep our feet dry in wet, muddy weather, but it is NOT your sandals. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: They are perfect for muddy puddles.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Did you know? cowboy boots have a special heel to stop the foot from slipping through a stirrup.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our clothes when the rain starts to fall. It is also worn on a gray, drizzly, splashy-puddle kind of day, but it is NOT your coat. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this on drizzly, puddle-splashing days.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: They usually feature a large hood to keep your hair dry.

quests.instruction: We wear this around our waist to hold our pants up. It is also worn so our trousers do not slip down while we play, but it is NOT your mittens. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: It buckles at the front to stay snug.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: Some belts are worn purely as a fashion statement over dresses.

quests.instruction: We wear this that lets us pretend to be someone completely different for a day, but it is not your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: You might wear one for a dress-up party or a play.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: They often include masks, makeup, and special props.

quests.instruction: We wear this that flows and twirls when we spin around. It is also worn instead of a shirt and skirt worn separately, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It often twirls when you spin.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Did you know? historically, dresses were the standard everyday clothing for most women.

quests.instruction: We wear this before we tie the laces or fasten the straps. It is also worn to protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground, but it is NOT your boots. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear socks underneath these.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the oldest known leather shoe is over 5,500 years old.

quests.instruction: We wear this that a magician or a waiter often wears at work. It is also worn for a very fancy party, tied just below our chin, but it is NOT your belt. What is it?
quests.hint: It is shaped like a little bow, not a long strip!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: Tying a real bow tie requires a special technique that takes practice.

quests.instruction: We wear this right after our warm bath in the evening. It is also worn instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives, but it is NOT your onesie. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: They are soft and loose, not tight.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the word 'pajama' comes from a Persian word meaning 'leg garment'.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our eyes on a bright, sunny day. It is also worn at the beach or on a sunny car ride, but it is NOT your cape. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these on a beach or on a bright day.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: They were originally invented to protect pilots' eyes while flying.

quests.instruction: We wear this that drapes loosely down over our shoulders and arms, but it is not your windbreaker. What is it?
quests.hint: It has no sleeves and no buttons.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: They do not have sleeves, giving your arms complete freedom to move.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of soft cotton pants, for extra-tough play, but it is not your tights. What is it?
quests.hint: They are made from a tough fabric called denim.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans get their blue color from a special dye called indigo.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this shaped like a favorite animal, with a soft hood and little ears, not your wetsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It sometimes looks like a cute animal.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: They usually snap or zip up the front.

quests.instruction: We wear this that looks a little like headphones, but for warmth. It is also worn instead of a hat, when only our ears feel cold, but it is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.hint: They cover just your ears, not your whole head!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Some earmuffs are also used to block out extremely loud noises.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part that can be short, long, or completely missing on a vest? It is not your collar!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You roll this up when you feel too warm.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: A tank top is a shirt that has absolutely no sleeves at all.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this made of thick, stretchy rubber that traps a thin layer of warmth, not your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Surfers wear this in cold ocean water.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: They are made of a spongy material called neoprene.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of a cap, when we want our whole head warm, but it is not your hat. What is it?
quests.hint: It is soft, stretchy, and knitted.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: They are very stretchy so one size can fit almost any head.

quests.instruction: We wear this that keeps our socks bone dry, no matter how deep the puddle, but it is not your flip-flops. What is it?
quests.hint: They are perfect for jumping in puddles.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: They are usually brightly colored, like yellow or red.

quests.instruction: We wear this under a jacket, so we still feel cool once it's off. It is also worn instead of a T-shirt, when even short sleeves feel too warm, but it is NOT your hoodie. What is it?
quests.hint: It has no sleeves, only two thin straps!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: They get their name from vintage 'tank suits' worn in swimming pools.
